mapper.sql: id, author_id, username, title, description, play_url, cover_url, create_time, likes_count, popularity
mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.author_id, v.username, v.title, v.description, v.play_url, v.cover_url, v.create_time, v.likes_count, v.popularity FROM videos v INNER JOIN video_tags vt ON vt.video_id = v.id INNER JOIN tags t ON t.id = vt.tag_id WHERE t.name = #{tagName} ORDER BY v.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM videos WHERE id IN #{id}
SELECT video_id FROM likes WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND video_id IN #{id}
